entities.summary: Bonaventura Corti was an Italian Jesuit priest and naturalist who contributed to studies on microscopic organisms including the rotifers, ciliates and algae. He coined the word "plantanimal" for plant-like organisms which moved and could be revived from desiccation through the addition of water.
